lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Larger subject displays 12 high-contrast vertical line segments with inter-line spacing increasing from the cranial end toward the mid-flank. Smaller subject displays 13 vertical line segments with tighter, more uniform spacing.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the larger subject at the dorsal origin of the third cranial line segment, where the line splits into two distinct paths near the spine.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Larger subject shows dashed/abbreviated line segments in the posterior quadrant, specifically the three lines closest to the rump which terminate before reaching the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Larger subject exhibits a cluster of 5 high-contrast spots on the lower posterior haunch. Smaller subject exhibits 3 spots on the haunch/hind-limb junction.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white facial markings including sub-orbital spots and snout chevrons are visible on both subjects; white markings also visible on the distal limbs above the hooves.
